CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS TO BANK OF AMERICA CORPORATION BY COURT AT SMALL CLAIM HEARING OF SEP-11-2017 AT 1:30 P.M. AT THE REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF KHATRA MUJADIDI. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF KHATRA MUJADIDI. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT BANK OF AMERICA. PLAINTIFF INFORMS THE COURT THAT SHE HAS REACHED AN AGREEMENT WITH DEFENDANT BANK OF AMERICA TODAY, 9/11/17. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHETY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-11-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-11-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF KHATRA MUJADIDI AND DEFENDANT'S REPRESENTATIVE STAR SCHICKLEY, SUPERVISOR FOR CREDIT BUREAU REPORTING FOR THE PENNSYLVANIA HIGHER EDUCATION ASSISTANCE AGENCY. NO PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE, BUT DEFENDANT'S REPRESENTATIVE WAIVED SERVICE A TODAY'S HEARING. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. PLAINTIFF DISMISSED DEFENDANT BANCK OF AMERICA CORPORATION, WITH PREJUDICE, AT TODAY'S HEARING. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-11-2017 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MUJADIDI, KHATRA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT PENNSYLVANIA HIGHER EDUCATION ASSISTANCE AGENCY AT PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST, PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM AGAINST DEFENDANT BANK OF AMERICA CORPORATION IS DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED.
